services.name: Programs & Events
services.desc: Step into New Tecumseth’s story. Discover exhibits, programs, events, and heritage experiences that bring local history and culture to life. Join us at Museum on the Boyne for Spuds and Sprouts - our Pre-K program that welcomes our youngest visitors to explore, play, and learn at the museum. Children ages 2-4 are invited to join us for hands-on crafts and sensory activities, bringing you and your little ones to the museum for creativity, community, and connection! Children must be accompanied by an adult.Creative Critters, September 12Harvest Vegetable Adventure, October 10Fall Fun, November 14 Start your morning with community, curiosity, and a warm cup in hand. services.name: Museum Exhibits
services.desc: Visit our local exhibit at the Museum on the Boyne and experience history up close. This exhibit surveys Canada’s rich linguistic landscape, including over 60 aboriginal languages, Canada’s two official language (English and French), and more than 100 languages that immigrants have brought to our shores. The exhibition explores themes that touch the lives of speakers of every language in Canada, such as: How have the languages of Canada changed over time? What happens when languages come in contact?
